title: Before… After! Roughly 8 weeks worth of implementation rounds claude plus subscription
author: ReasonCandid1470
selftext:
Hey guys, just wanted to share some progress on a personal project, its a deep action roguelike with 100s of weapons, items and armours to pick up throughout runs, where you can progress through biomes and routes in a hallucinated world. Binding of isaac is one of my favourite games and Id love to one day end up with a game as full of content that boi is! 

Players pick up weapons throughout a run which all have their own moveset and special abilities, each attack is aimed individually, players can dodge and jump throught attacks. They can pick up items and armours which add passive effects like other roguelikes.

Currently have 2 completed routes with a minimum of 4 biomes each, some routes have multiple options of which biomes the player wants to play through, increasing in difficulty as you progress.

Each biomes has its own item pool, enemies and multiple bosses, each room and floor is randomly generated each time, from the enemies and items to the visual look.

Any feedback would be greatly appreciated, definitely some visual polish needs to be done on hits and animations, same with sound fx and ui - no surprise on that last one using claude. 

Thanks!

replies.author: Ok-Investment4414
replies.body:
sure saying you need way more time like over 100k hours and ai can get u there much faster... come on bro your char is clearly a monkey king inspired , still stiff af graphics are basic shapes , the combat still basic.   
  
You have played or seen a version of your game before so why even ask for constructive feedback as if your brand new. Idk if this will be for sale but it's brutal out there everyone is doing what u have now at the base level so u have to do more. Then there is the anti ai mob , this feeds them .   
  
Yeah this isn't the final form but its still at the entry level . In 1999 sure but in 2026 - 27 a 5 year old can make this in a week. 

Buyers expectations have risen
